$comment: chief-wiggum#238 validation: accrualflow re-authored through /plan-bet. Grounding: canvas.value-proposition/customer-segment/pricing/competitive-position asm_ids match the REAL accrualflow assumptions.json depends_on_element join exactly (ASM-001/002/003/004). canvas.key-metrics is the real kill-criteria.json's three metric names verbatim. structure.distribution_channel_type/acquisition come from the real bet.json acquisition.ecosystem_channel (xero-app-store). premortem PM-001/PM-004/PM-005 map to ASM-004/ASM-003/ASM-001 respectively (the real bet's own untested assumptions); PM-002/PM-003 are explicitly waived with reasons tied to real facts (the rep-cadence miss and the ASM-004 dedup) rather than invented filler. No canvas field is marked validated/falsified: every real ASM in accrualflow's ledger is still 'untested'/'testing', and this artifact does not manufacture evidence status the real record does not have. fermi_inputs is DELIBERATELY OMITTED — the real bet was parked before that arithmetic was ever run; see business-model-fermi-illustrative.json for a clearly-labelled illustrative variant.

problem.value: AU bookkeepers/practices manage prepayment and accrual amortization schedules by hand in spreadsheets, error-prone across multiple client files.

customer-segment.value: AU bookkeeping practices currently running spreadsheet prepayment schedules, reached via accountant-community channels.

value-proposition.value: Auto-post amortization journals from tagged invoices in Xero — removes the manual spreadsheet reconciliation step across a practice's whole client base.

solution.value: Tag an invoice as a prepayment/accrual in Xero; the app schedules and auto-posts the amortization journals for its term.

channels.value: Xero App Store (ecosystem-partner distribution) — practices discover the app inside the platform they already use daily.

revenue-streams.value: Per-practice SaaS subscription; a statements/reconciliation add-on planned as a second SKU once the core wedge validates.

cost-structure.value: Hosting, Xero API usage, and support time — no paid headcount at this stage.

key-metrics.value: smoke_signups, commitment_class_signals, paid_commitments — the bet's own pre-registered kill-criteria metrics, not a separate metric set invented for this stage.

unfair-advantage.value: AU-specific focus plus multi-org practice pricing — the differentiation axis ASM-001/ASM-004 name as still untested against known incumbents.

pricing.value: USD 19 pre-order deposit at waitlist stage; ongoing per-practice subscription price not yet set.

competitive-position.value: A low-cost incumbent add-on module and a discovered direct competitor twin already operate in this ecosystem; whether a real differentiation axis (reconciliation, multi-org pricing, AU focus) survives contact with them is untested.

premortem.statement: A direct competitor twin already serves this niche in the same ecosystem, further along (private beta) and accountant-built.
A low-cost incumbent add-on module already covers the core prepayment-posting need.
premortem.waiver_reason: Same differentiation question as PM-001/ASM-004 (competitive-position) — tracked there rather than duplicating a second assumption for the same untested axis.

premortem.statement: Distribution is never actually attempted — the bet accumulates spend/time without a single Mom-Test conversation.
premortem.waiver_reason: This is an execution-discipline risk, not a testable market hypothesis — covered by bet.py's rep-cadence check against the ledger, not the ASM traceability graph.

premortem.statement: The USD 19 pre-order deposit is too low a bar to be a meaningful commitment signal at n=40 waitlisted practices.
AU bookkeepers do not perceive prepayment/accrual tracking as painful enough to switch tools away from spreadsheets.

pains.value: Manual, spreadsheet-based prepayment/accrual amortization tracking across every client file in a practice.

pain_relievers.value: Auto-post amortization journals from tagged invoices — the schedule and the posting both become automatic.
